title: Classify a helpdesk ticket
system: You classify IT helpdesk tickets. Output only the requested answer.
prompt:
Classify this helpdesk ticket into exactly one of: hardware, software, network, access, billing.
Reply with only that one word.

Ticket from Jane Example (jane.example@example.com), Acme Widgets Ltd:
"My laptop screen is flickering and has a crack in the corner after I dropped it this morning. I cannot read the display."
